lines.en: label harukainvite3:
I tap on Haruka’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我点开手机里 Haruka 的名字，等着她接。

lines.en: Ami told me earlier today that she wouldn’t be around, so I figure now is as good a time as any to bring someone over.
lines.zh: Ami 今天早些时候跟我说她不在，所以我觉得现在正是带人过来的好时机。

lines.en: Plus, Haruka and I never got to do anything fun after our bar hopping adventure, so I would like to make up for lost {i}intimate time{/i} if at all possible.
lines.zh: 再说，我们上次串酒吧之后就没再干过什么好玩的事，所以我想尽可能把错过的{i}「亲密时光」{/i}补回来。

lines.en: And while I agree with all of that stuff she recently said about how it's nice to hang out without any of the more physical parts of our relationship getting in the way...
lines.zh: 虽然我同意她最近说的那些——我们之间能不掺杂肉体部分、单纯地相处也挺好的……

lines.en: The physical stuff is still my favorite part.
lines.zh: 可肉体部分依然是我的最爱。

lines.en: And it’s the only reason this relationship exists in the first place, so...
lines.zh: 而且它本来就是这段关系存在的唯一理由，所以……

lines.en: Yeah, I’m pretty sure you’re able to guess what’s on my mind today.
lines.zh: 是啊，我敢肯定你猜得到我今天在想什么。

lines.en: : Hey! What’s up?
lines.zh: : 嘿！怎么啦？

lines.en: : Not much. Are you still at work?
lines.zh: : 没什么。你还在上班吗？

lines.en: : Nope! It was actually kind of dead today, so I let the rest of the staff take over.
lines.zh: : 没了！今天其实挺冷清的，所以我就让其他员工接手了。

lines.en: : Rin’s there tonight as well, so-
lines.zh: : 而且今晚 Rin 也在，所以——

lines.en: : You should come over.
lines.zh: : 你应该过来。

lines.en: : I should?
lines.zh: : 我应该？

lines.en: : You should.
lines.zh: : 你应该。

lines.en: : Huh.
: Well, then I guess I should.
lines.zh: : 那好吧，我想我应该过去。

lines.en: : Am I just meeting you there or am I coming in?
lines.zh: : 我是在那边跟你会合，还是进屋去？

lines.en: : Coming in, preferably.
lines.zh: : 最好是进屋。

lines.en: : Is your [niece] around?
lines.zh: : 你[侄女]在吗？

lines.en: : She is not.
lines.zh: : 她不在。

lines.en: : I see, I see.
lines.zh: : 这样啊，这样啊。

lines.en: : Okay. Yeah, I’ll head over now.
lines.zh: : 好吧。嗯，我现在就过去。

lines.en: : Sounds good. See you soon, Haruka.
lines.zh: : 听起来不错。一会儿见，Haruka。

lines.en: : Yup! See you soon.
lines.zh: : 嗯！一会儿见。

lines.en: scene black
I hang up the phone as soon as the plans are set in stone and begin the journey back.
lines.zh: 计划一定下来，我就挂了电话，踏上回家的路。

lines.en: The tone of Haruka’s voice carried a bit of disappointment when she found out we weren’t just meeting up and that she was coming in-
lines.zh: Haruka 听说我们不是在外面碰头、而是要她进屋时，语气里带着一点失望——

lines.en: But I’m sure that tone will change within a very short amount of time.
lines.zh: 不过我敢肯定，那语气很快就会变的。

lines.en: It always does with her.
lines.zh: 对她来说，一向如此。

lines.en: scene harukathirdinvite1
: Hey! Sorry if I took a little while. I was in the middle of dinner when you called, so...didn’t want to leave in the middle of that.
lines.zh: : 嘿！抱歉我耽搁了一会儿。你打电话的时候我正在吃晚饭，所以……不想吃到一半就走。

lines.en: : It’s fine. I just got back myself.
lines.zh: : 没事。我自己也是刚回来。

lines.en: : Wow, you wanted to see me so much that you invited me over before you were even home?
lines.zh: : 哇，你这么想见我，连自己还没到家就先把我叫来了？

lines.en: : I just call that being good at time management.
lines.zh: : 我把这叫做时间管理得好。

lines.en: : And, speaking of which...
lines.zh: : 而且，说到这个……

lines.en: : Speaking of which, {i}what?{/i}
lines.zh: : 说到这个，{i}什么{/i}？

lines.en: : Do you have a good idea of how you’d like to spend our time together tonight?
lines.zh: : 你想好今晚我们要怎么打发时间了吗？

lines.en: : A very good idea, actually. I think we should-
lines.zh: : 其实想得挺清楚的。我觉得我们应该——

lines.en: : Hang out on the couch and talk to each other?
lines.zh: : 窝在沙发上聊聊天？

lines.en: : Uhh, my idea actually involved a little less clothing.
lines.zh: : 呃，我的想法其实涉及少穿一点衣服。

lines.en: : Will it appease you if I take my hoodie off?
lines.zh: : 那我把连帽衫脱了能安抚你吗？

lines.en: : Sure. As long as you take the rest of your clothes off with it.
lines.zh: : 当然。只要你把剩下的衣服也一起脱了。

lines.en: : We can’t do it today, if that’s what you’re getting at.
lines.zh: : 今天不行，如果你指的是那个的话。

lines.en: : Why not?
lines.zh: : 为什么不行？

lines.en: : Because {i}we can’t do it today.{/i}
lines.zh: : 因为{i}今天就是不行{/i}。

lines.en: : Why does this always happen to me?
lines.zh: : 为什么这种事总发生在我身上？

lines.en: scene harukathirdinvite2
: Uhh...always?
lines.zh: : 呃……总是？

lines.en: : Well, not always. But this is definitely not the first time that-
lines.zh: : 嗯，也不总是。但这绝对不是第一次——

lines.en: : Oh. You’re upset because that insinuates there are other people.
lines.zh: : 哦。你生气了，因为这话暗示还有别的人。

lines.en: : Well, I...I mean, of course there are other people. That’s...That’s pretty obvious with the way you conduct yourself.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我……我是说，当然有别人。看你的行事作风，这……这挺明显的。

lines.en: : And it’s not like I’m really...the best person to comment on that sort of thing, since...
lines.zh: : 而且我也实在……不是最有资格评论这种事的人，毕竟……

lines.en: scene harukathirdinvite3
: You know what? Let’s not talk about that right now.
lines.zh: : 算了。我们现在别谈这个了。

lines.en: : I’ve been in a pretty good mood all day and I kind of want to shut my brain off.
lines.zh: : 我今天一整天心情都挺好的，我想把脑子关掉。

lines.en: : And I’m assuming that’s why you didn’t want to stick around here?
lines.zh: : 我猜，这就是你不想在这儿久留的原因？

lines.en: scene harukathirdinvite4
: That and I had so much fun the last time we actually went out that I was kind of hoping it was going to happen again.
lines.zh: : 这是一方面，还有上次我们真的出去玩得太开心了，我还挺希望再来一次的。

lines.en: : And it will. I just don’t feel like going out again today now that I’m home.
lines.zh: : 会的。只是我都到家了，今天实在不想再出门。

lines.en: : That’s fine. I mean, this is what we do best anyway.
lines.zh: : 没关系。反正我们最擅长的就是这个。

lines.en: : We’ll just chill on the couch and watch TV or something.
lines.zh: : 我们就窝在沙发上看看电视什么的。

lines.en: : Can you at least inform me of whether or not there is a blowjob on the way to me in the near future?
lines.zh: : 那你至少告诉我一声，近期会不会有一个口活在赶来见我的路上？

lines.en: scene harukathirdinvite5
: Jesus, are you really that turned on right now?
lines.zh: : 天哪，你现在真的这么欲火中烧吗？

lines.en: : This is just what life for me is like, Haruka. It’s incredibly sad.
lines.zh: : 我的生活就是这样的，Haruka。可悲至极。

lines.en: : I mean, I definitely get it. It just sounds like you’re going to die without any action.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我当然懂。只是听起来你像是没得做就会死。

lines.en: : I very well may.
lines.zh: : 很有可能。

lines.en: scene harukathirdinvite6
: Did you get blueballed by one of the girls in your class or something?
lines.zh: : 你是被班里哪个女生吊着没给操吗，还是怎么的？

lines.en: : I have no idea what you’re talking about. The only person I am sexually involved with is a local cafe owner with pink hair.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你在说什么。我唯一有性关系的，是一位粉头发的本地咖啡馆老板。

lines.en: : One of my competitors has pink hair. You’re not fucking the enemy, are you?
lines.zh: : 我的竞争对手里就有一个粉头发的。你该不会在操敌人吧？

lines.en: : I am not fucking the enemy.
lines.zh: : 我没有在操敌人。

lines.en: : Because if you’re fucking the enemy, I’m going to be really pissed.
lines.zh: : 因为如果你在操敌人，我会非常生气。

lines.en: : I don’t even know who the enemy is.
lines.zh: : 我连敌人是谁都不知道。

lines.en: : You should have just told me that it {i}was{/i} one of your students who did this to you. That would have been a lot more exciting.
lines.zh: : 你干脆直接告诉我{i}是{/i}你哪个学生把你弄成这样的好了。那样刺激多了。

lines.en: : Sometimes, I think you might like [teenage]girls more than I do.
lines.zh: : 有时候我觉得，你可能比我还喜欢[teenage]女孩。

lines.en: scene harukathirdinvite1
: That’s fine, because I’m pretty sure Rin likes them more than both of us combined.
lines.zh: : 没关系，因为我敢肯定 Rin 比我们俩加起来还喜欢她们。

lines.en: : I...really can’t disagree with that.
lines.zh: : 我……实在没法反驳。

lines.en: : It’s kind of unhealthy, actually.
lines.zh: : 说实话，这有点不太健康。

lines.en: : Definitely.
lines.zh: : 确实。

lines.en: : So, are we done standing around yet? Because your couch looks really comfortable and I would like to one day sit on it.
lines.zh: : 那我们站够了没有？你家沙发看起来真的很舒服，我总有一天想坐上去。

lines.en: : I have somehow not managed to do that despite being inside on multiple occasions now. You are a horrible host.
lines.zh: : 我都进来好几次了，却不知怎么一直没能坐上去。你这主人当得真烂。

lines.en: : Fine. But I still want to know about the blowjob thing.
lines.zh: : 好吧。可我还是想知道口活那件事的答案。

lines.en: scene harukathirdinvite7
: Okay, you really might have some sort of problem if this is all you can think of.
lines.zh: : 好吧，要是你满脑子只有这个，那你大概是真有什么毛病。

lines.en: : Even I’m not this bad and I have spent well over 100,000 yen at Maki’s store.
lines.zh: : 连我都没这么夸张，而我在 Maki 的店里已经花掉了十万多日元。

lines.en: : That is...incredibly depressing.
lines.zh: : 这……真是压抑到极点。

lines.en: : I am...so very lonely.
lines.zh: : 我……真的好孤独。

lines.en: scene black
Haruka and I swallow our self-pity (The same way I hope that she swallows my semen before the night’s end) and take a seat on the couch...
lines.zh: Haruka 和我咽下各自的自怜（就像我希望她在今晚结束前咽下我的精液那样），在沙发上坐下……

She pulls her knees up against her chest and moves closer to me than she normally does when the two of us are alone together like this.
lines.zh: 她把膝盖收到胸前，靠得比我们像这样单独相处时通常的距离更近。

lines.en: Well...when we're not naked, I mean.
lines.zh: 嗯……我是说，在我们没光着的时候。

lines.en: Her clothes smell similar to Nodoka’s in that they’re essentially permanently stained with the essence of coffee, but Haruka’s also contain a tinge of...
lines.zh: 她衣服的味道和 Nodoka 有点像——基本上都永久浸着咖啡的精华，不过 Haruka 的还带着一丝……

lines.en: : Lemon?
lines.zh: : 柠檬？

lines.en: : Uhh...I’m sorry?
lines.zh: : 呃……你说什么？

lines.en: : Oh. Nothing. Thinking out loud.
lines.zh: : 哦。没什么。自言自语而已。

lines.en: : Of...lemons?
lines.zh: : 关于……柠檬？

lines.en: : I...guess so.
lines.zh: : 我……大概是吧。

lines.en: : Anyway, now what?
lines.zh: : 总之，接下来干嘛？

lines.en: : We’re not having sex and it’s becoming depressingly apparent that nothing else is going to happen either, so our choices are either watching television or...talking.
lines.zh: : 我们不做爱，而且越来越令人沮丧地明显——别的也不会发生，所以我们的选择要么是看电视，要么……聊天。

lines.en: : Do you not like talking?
lines.zh: : 你不喜欢聊天吗？

lines.en: : It’s not that. I just think you like talking a little too much sometimes.
lines.zh: : 不是不喜欢。我只是觉得你有时候话有点太多了。

lines.en: scene harukathirdinvite9
: Well excuse me for wanting to converse with you!
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉我想跟你说话了！

lines.en: : It’s just not often that someone is able to hear all of my rambling and not think I’m annoying, so yeah. I’m going to talk a lot.
lines.zh: : 只是很少有人能听完我这些絮叨还不觉得我烦，所以是啊。我要说个够。

lines.en: : You know, once you’re surrounded by a class of twenty [teenage]girls, it’s kind of hard to be annoyed by anything else ever again.
lines.zh: : 你知道，一旦被二十个[teenage]女孩围在班里，之后就很难再被别的事惹烦了。

lines.en: : It’s one of the three big reasons I keep inviting you over instead of any of them.
lines.zh: : 这是我一直请你来、而不是请她们中任何一个的三大理由之一。

lines.en: scene harukathirdinvite10
: If you tell me that the other two are my boobs, I-
lines.zh: : 你要是告诉我另外两个是我的奶子，我——

lines.en: : The other two are your boobs.
lines.zh: : 另外两个就是你的奶子。

lines.en: : Why am I even here right now?
lines.zh: : 我到底为什么还在这儿？

lines.en: : Because, for some strange reason, you enjoy being around me.
lines.zh: : 因为，出于某种奇怪的理由，你喜欢跟我在一起。

lines.en: scene harukathirdinvite11
: Yeah...it {i}is{/i} kind of strange, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 是啊……这{i}确实{/i}挺奇怪的，对吧？

lines.en: : You’re a jerk...you have an annoyingly busy schedule...and you’re probably fucking both of my friends.
lines.zh: : 你是个混蛋……你的日程忙得让人烦……而且你大概在操我的两个朋友。

lines.en: scene harukathirdinvite12
: Like...putting your thing in...their things...
lines.zh: : 就是……把你的那个……放进……她们的那里……

lines.en: : You can use adult words in this house, Haruka. You’re not going to get in trouble.
lines.zh: : 在我家你可以用成年人的词，Haruka。你不会惹麻烦的。

lines.en: : Besides, I can say with confidence that I am not fucking {i}both{/i} of your friends.
lines.zh: : 再说，我可以很肯定地说，我没有在操你的{i}两个{/i}朋友。

lines.zh: : 大概是有个跟我同岁的女人，我更喜欢一点吧。

lines.en: : Also, may I remind you of the three reasons that I continue to invite you-
lines.zh: : 另外，容我提醒你我一直邀请你的那三个理由——

lines.en: scene harukathirdinvite14
: No. You may not.

lines.en: : Damn it.

: But...umm...

lines.zh: : 有点像……我总算在哪件事上赢了她们俩一次。

lines.en: : Well...uhh...thanks for telling me?...
lines.zh: : 嗯……呃……谢谢你告诉我？……

lines.en: : Any time, Haruka. This is what friends are for.
lines.zh: : 随时奉告，Haruka。朋友就是干这个的。

lines.en: : Is it really, though?
lines.zh: : 真的吗，不过？

lines.en: : Anyway, the fact of the matter is...and forgive me for saying something remotely kind right now, I enjoy being around you as well.
lines.zh: : 总之，事实是……原谅我此刻说了句稍微温柔点的话，我也喜欢跟你在一起。

lines.zh: : 我……觉得这句话有一百万种更好听的说法。

lines.en: : Like...I still see you as a friend. I’m not saying I’m in love with you or anything.
lines.zh: : 就是……我依然把你当朋友。我不是说我爱上你了之类的。

lines.en: : But...I think about you a lot more than someone should be thinking about a friend. And not just when I’m horny or...when I’m lonely.
lines.zh: : 可是……我想你的次数，比一个朋友该被想起的次数多太多了。而且不光是在我发情的时候……或者孤独的时候。

lines.en: : But when I’m doing all kinds of things.
lines.zh: : 而是在我做各种各样事情的时候。

lines.en: : Like...the other day, I passed by some restaurant and the first thing I thought was, “It would be nice to go there with Sensei.”
lines.zh: : 比如……前几天我路过一家餐厅，脑子里第一个念头就是，「要是能和 Sensei 一起去就好了」。

lines.en: scene harukathirdinvite19
: That’s...that’s kind of weird, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 这……这有点奇怪吧？

lines.en: : Like...that’s not the kind of relationship we have...and I still can’t help but think of things that way.
lines.zh: : 就是……我们不是那种关系……可我还是忍不住会那么想。

lines.en: : I’m sure that...being alone for so long must have something to do with it, but...
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定……独处了这么久肯定跟这有关，可是……

lines.en: : Yeah. That’s one of the several points that I wanted to make about...this.
lines.zh: : 嗯。这就是我想说的几个点之一，关于……这个。

lines.en: : It’s...It’s just nice, you know?
lines.zh: : 就是……就是挺好的，你懂吗？

lines.en: From either up above or down below, I hope the most important person to her is listening in.
lines.zh: 不管是来自天上还是地下，我希望对她最重要的那个人正在听着。

lines.en: I hope he’s listening in and realizing that this rose belongs to me now.
lines.zh: 我希望他正在听着，并且意识到这朵玫瑰现在属于我了。

lines.en: That the flower he planted and subsequently spent years cultivating has been plucked from his garden and dropped haphazardly into a shallow vase full of dirty, unfiltered tap water.
lines.zh: 那朵他种下、又花了好些年培育的花，已经被人从他的花园里摘走，随手丢进一个盛着脏兮兮、未经过滤的自来水的浅花瓶里。

lines.en: This is the power of all that I am.
lines.zh: 这就是我全部存在所拥有的力量。

lines.en: The power of the center of the solar system.
lines.zh: 太阳系中心的力量。

lines.en: Everything flows into me- and I flow back into them.
lines.zh: 万物都流向我——而我又流回它们之中。

lines.en: A cycle of endless orgasms and secrets spanning across an infinite plane of time that exists for no discernible reason, but exists nonetheless.
lines.zh: 一个由无止境的高潮与秘密组成的循环，横跨在一片无限的时间平面上——那平面看不出存在的理由，却依然存在。

lines.en: True love is a lie.
lines.zh: 真爱是个谎言。

lines.en: All flowers need water.
lines.zh: 所有的花都需要水。

lines.en: You can not plant one and leave it alone.
lines.zh: 你不能种下一朵花之后就对它不管不顾。

lines.en: And if you do, be prepared for the worst.
lines.zh: 如果你真这么做，那就做好最坏的打算吧。

lines.en: Luckily for Haruka’s husband, wherever he may be, if he even {i}is{/i} at all-
lines.zh: 对 Haruka 的丈夫来说幸运的{i}是{/i}——不管他在哪儿，如果他还在的话——

lines.en: I will gladly tend to his roses.
lines.zh: 我会很乐意替他照料他的玫瑰。

lines.en: I will tend to every single rose in every single garden.
lines.zh: 我会照料每一座花园里的每一朵玫瑰。

lines.en: And I will smile as I do it.
lines.zh: 而且我做的时候会微笑着。

lines.en: : Yeah...
: It is nice.
lines.zh: : 是挺好的。

lines.en: scene harukathirdinvite20
: I’m home!
lines.zh: : 我回来了！

lines.en: scene harukathirdinvite21
Bury me in {s}you{/s} worms.
lines.zh: 用虫子把我埋了吧。

lines.en: scene harukathirdinvite22
: Hey. Welcome back.
lines.zh: : 嘿。欢迎回来。

lines.en: : Hey, Ami. We were just going to watch TV.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Ami。我们正打算看电视。

lines.en: So, I obviously know this doesn’t look good.
lines.zh: 所以，我当然知道这看起来不妙。

lines.en: But, based on prior experience, this really isn’t even half as bad as it could have been.
lines.zh: 不过，根据以往的经验，这其实连本来可能有的糟糕程度的一半都不到。

lines.en: I’m actually somehow thankful that we didn’t wind up having sex today because...well, you can probably imagine why.
lines.zh: 我甚至有点庆幸我们今天最终没做成，因为……嗯，你大概能想象为什么。

lines.en: Still, though.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来。

lines.en: Ami is sensitive as-is, so we’ll need to navigate this carefully if-
lines.zh: Ami 本来就敏感，所以我们得小心处理，如果——

lines.en: : Aren’t you married?
lines.zh: : 你不是结婚了吗？

lines.en: scene harukathirdinvite23
Or...I guess we’re just going to jump straight to that.
lines.zh: 或者……我猜我们是要直接跳到这一步了。

lines.en: : You what?
lines.zh: : 你什么？

lines.en: : You are, right?
lines.zh: : 你是，对吧？

lines.en: scene harukathirdinvite24
: Because I asked Molly more about you the other day after you stole Sensei away and she told me you were.
lines.zh: : 因为前几天你把 Sensei 抢走之后，我向 Molly 多问了问你的事，她跟我说你结婚了。

lines.en: : Was Molly lying to me?
lines.zh: : Molly 是在骗我吗？

lines.en: : Or are you just a whore?
lines.zh: : 还是说你就是个婊子？

lines.en: : We’re...we’re just sitting here! Nothing happened!
lines.zh: : 我们……我们只是坐在这儿而已！什么都没发生！

lines.en: : Ami, really. Nothing happened.
lines.zh: : Ami，真的。什么都没发生。

lines.en: : She looks awfully close to you for “nothing,” Sensei.
lines.zh: : 就「什么都没发生」而言，她挨你挨得也太近了吧，Sensei。

lines.en: : I don’t think her {i}husband{/i} would like it very much if he saw the two of you like this.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她{i}丈夫{/i}要是看到你俩这样，肯定不会太高兴。

lines.en: : We’re not-
lines.zh: : 我们不是——

lines.en: : Sorry, would you mind getting off the couch if you’re going to talk to me?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你要跟我说话的话，能不能先从沙发上起来？

lines.en: : I’m having a hard time focusing when you’re that close to {i}my{/i} Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你离{i}我的{/i} Sensei 那么近，我很难集中注意力。

lines.en: : Ami...come on.
lines.zh: : Ami……别这样。

lines.en: : No...No, I should probably get going.
lines.zh: : 不……不，我大概该走了。

lines.en: : She’s...she’s right. I {i}am{/i} married...and...and...
lines.zh: : 她……她{i}是{/i}对的。我结婚了……而且……而且……

lines.en: : Huh?
scene harukathirdinvite25
: Where did all these tears come from?
lines.zh: : 这些眼泪是从哪儿冒出来的？

lines.en: : Are you crying now?
lines.zh: : 你现在在哭吗？

lines.en: : Why are you crying if you didn’t do anything wrong?
lines.zh: : 既然你没做错什么，你为什么要哭？

lines.en: : Could it be that maybe you already {i}did{/i} something wrong and you’re so overcome with guilt that you’re having trouble stomaching it?
lines.zh: : 会不会是你其实已经{i}做错了{/i}什么，内疚得受不了，连胃里都难受了？

lines.en: : Do you want a bucket? Sensei used to bring me a bucket when I was feeling nauseous.
lines.zh: : 要桶吗？我恶心想吐的时候，Sensei 以前都会给我拿个桶来。

lines.en: : That’s a thing I know he does because he’s been with me for years and you’ve only known him for a few months.
lines.zh: : 我知道他会这么做，是因为他跟我在一起好几年了，而你才认识他几个月。

lines.en: : Ami, stop.
lines.zh: : Ami，够了。

lines.en: : Why? I live here. That’s my couch.
lines.zh: : 为什么？我住这儿。那是我的沙发。

lines.en: : She’s in my spot. I want her gone.
lines.zh: : 她占了我的位置。我要她走。

lines.en: scene harukathirdinvite26
: So much for her not being around today...
lines.zh: : 说好的她今天不在呢……

lines.en: : I really had no idea.
lines.zh: : 我真的不知道。

lines.en: : I knew she liked you, but...doesn’t this seem a little excessive?
lines.zh: : 我知道她喜欢你，可是……这也太夸张了吧？

lines.en: : Who are you to judge what is and isn’t excessive, you fucking slut?
lines.zh: : 你算什么东西，也配评判什么叫夸张，你这个该死的荡妇？

lines.en: : Get away from my [uncle]. I don’t want him catching any STDs or other icky stuff that might impact how much time he gets to spend with me.
lines.zh: : 离我的[叔叔]远点。我可不想让他染上什么性病，或者其他会影响他陪我时间的恶心东西。

lines.en: scene harukathirdinvite27
: Isn’t that enough? She’s already crying.
lines.zh: : 够了没有？她都哭了。

lines.en: : I get that you want to keep me to yourself, but Haruka is a friend of mine. You can’t talk to her like that.
lines.zh: : 我知道你想把我占为己有，可 Haruka 是我的朋友。你不能这么跟她说话。

lines.en: : Sure I can. You heard her, right? She’s married.
lines.zh: : 我当然能。你听到她的话了，对吧？她结婚了。

lines.en: : I’m saving everybody a load of heartbreak right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在是在帮所有人省掉一大堆心碎。

lines.en: : She’s...got a point...
lines.zh: : 她说得……有道理……

lines.en: : It would...be best for everyone if...I just went home for the night.
lines.zh: : 对大家都好的话……我还是今晚回家吧。

lines.en: : Sensei, when she leaves, what do you want me to make you for dinner?
lines.zh: : Sensei，等她走了，晚餐你想让我给你做什么？

lines.en: : Can you at least go into your room and let me say goodbye to her alone?
lines.zh: : 你能不能先回房间，让我单独跟她道个别？

lines.en: : I’d really rather not.
lines.zh: : 我真的不太想。

lines.en: scene harukathirdinvite28
: {i}Let’s...go out next time, okay?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}下次……我们出去吧，好吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I don’t really think I’m welcome here...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我觉得我在这儿不太受欢迎……{/i}

lines.en: : Sure...
scene black
Haruka quickly scurries out of the living room without making eye contact with Ami.
lines.zh: Haruka 快步溜出客厅，自始至终没有和 Ami 对上眼。

lines.en: But what’s so confusing to me is that, even though she was confronted and berated from the moment Ami came home, she still suggested a “next time.”
lines.zh: 可让我困惑的是，尽管从 Ami 踏进家门那一刻起她就被质问、被训斥，她还是提出了「下次」。

lines.en: Is she really so lonely that she’s fine with risking another run-in like this for a chance to be with me?
lines.zh: 她真的孤独到愿意冒再遇上这种场面的风险，只为换取跟我在一起的机会吗？

lines.en: Why?
lines.zh: 为什么？

lines.en: Oh, right.
lines.zh: 哦，对了。

lines.en: She can’t help it.
lines.zh: 她控制不住。

lines.en: She’s already in my vase.
lines.zh: 她已经在我的花瓶里了。

lines.en: : Sensei! Watch a movie and cuddle with me!
lines.zh: : Sensei！陪我看电影、抱抱我！

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: I watch a movie and cuddle with Ami.
lines.zh: 我陪 Ami 看了场电影，抱了她。

lines.zh: {i}Ami 的好感度提升到了 [ami_love]!{/i}
